_agent_hints.about: Keys starting with _ are ignored by repogov and exist only to guide AI agents. Read before editing files or this config.
_agent_hints.on_limit_fail: A FAIL means a file is over its line limit. Split or trim the file (move detail into docs/ and link to it). Do NOT raise a limit in this config just to make the check pass unless the user asks.
_agent_hints.on_limit_warn: A WARN means the file is at or above the warning threshold. Prefer trimming before adding more content.
_agent_hints.adding_exemptions: To exempt a file set its limit to 0 under files. Only do this for generated or append-only files (e.g. CHANGELOG.md), and tell the user.
never_do: Never create, edit, or seed .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json; they belong to the user.
Never open or paste the contents of .claude/.credentials.json, *.pem, *.key, *.crt, *.p12, *.pfx, *.jks or .env files.
Never overwrite existing instruction or rule files; repogov init only creates missing files.
_agent_hints.verify: Run 'repogov -root . all' (or with -agent <name>) and the project's tests before finishing. Every non-PASS finding includes a '-- FIX:' hint; apply it.
_agent_hints.settings_audit: For the claude agent, layout also audits .claude/settings*.json. Fix duplicate, redundant, or allow/deny-conflicting permission rules by editing the list the finding names, and report to the user rather than widening permissions.
_agent_hints.silent_failures: Findings under 'agent pitfalls' mean an agent will silently ignore that file (no error from the agent). Apply the FIX hint; do not leave the file as is. A byte-limit FAIL means the agent may truncate the file even though the line count passes.

keys.default: Fallback line limit (0 falls back to 500).
keys.warning_threshold: Percent of limit at which WARN begins; accepts 85 or "85%".
keys.rules: Glob rules, first match wins; per-file entries in files take precedence.
keys.max_bytes: Byte-size limits by glob (first match wins), checked in addition to line limits; some agents truncate instruction files by size, e.g. 24000 bytes.
keys.files: Exact repo-relative path (forward slashes) to limit; 0 exempts.
